Container.Name: NetSpy
Container.Description: Live network + disk monitoring: per-interface, per-process and per-container throughput, disk I/O, CPU/RAM, latency, storage history and SSH terminals.
Container.Overview: Web dashboard showing real-time network + disk monitoring of Unraid (and other hosts): interface rates, per-process breakdown (incl. SMB sessions per client), per-container traffic, disk I/O per process, CPU/RAM per process, latency/health, storage fill-level history and SSH web terminals. One image, two roles — this template installs the web role; add agents on other hosts (TrueNAS/Debian) via the repo's docker-compose.yml.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: network monitor traffic throughput dashboard disk io cpu ram latency settings servers terminal ssh timezone
Container.Changes: v0.7.35: container timezone support (TZ, tzdata now in the image) - the storage history closes its day and month at local midnight instead of 02:00 (UTC); CONFIG_DIR exposed in the template. v0.7.34: fixed the dashboard staying empty when one server had not delivered a RAM sample yet (500 on /api/dashboard); stale parser self-test fixed. v0.7.33: new cheat-sheet group "Processes - find & kill" (ps/pgrep/pidof, kill and kill -9, pkill, lsof, ss on ports) - 77 commands in 8 groups. v0.7.32: mouse-wheel scrolling in the terminals works (tmux owns the scrollback; tmux mouse on). v0.7.30/0.7.31: page and list scrollbars are always visible (overlay-scrollbar fix). v0.7.22-0.7.29: command-list tooltip rebuilt - it can no longer stick or survive leaving the browser (root cause: missing CSS rule for the hidden state). v0.7.18-0.7.21: Linux command cheat sheet next to the terminals - 60 commands in 7 groups, incl. Unraid (mover, mdcmd) and TrueNAS/ZFS (zpool clear, zpool replace), plus favorites. v0.7.17: monitored servers automatically appear as SSH targets in Settings (enter the user, save). v0.7.15/0.7.16: terminal cards reorderable without killing the SSH session (CSS order instead of DOM moves) and auto-scroll while resizing. v0.7.13/0.7.14: drag & drop reorder fix; the SSH host-key prompt no longer reappears on every reconnect. v0.7.12: Terminal tab behind a login (TTYD_USER/TTYD_PASS - the terminals unlock only after logging in, the dashboard stays open).

Config.Name: ROLE
Config.Description: Role: web = dashboard + local sampler (this host); agent = collector for another web instance.

Config.Name: SERVERS
Config.Description: Servers the dashboard polls, semicolon-separated: Name=local;Name=http://host:8091. 'local' samples this host directly; http://... polls an agent on another host. Once the config volume is mounted and servers.yaml exists there, that file wins over this variable.

Config.Name: UPLINK
Config.Description: Optional override of the uplink interfaces (comma-separated, e.g. br0,bond0). Empty = auto-detect via default route (br0 on Unraid).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone inside the container, e.g. Europe/Berlin. It sets the day and month boundary of the storage history (daily/monthly fill level is fixed at local midnight instead of 02:00 with UTC) and all timestamps. Empty = UTC.

Config.Name: PORT:8090
Config.Description: Host port of the web UI. Host networking: the value IS the host port.

Config.Name: PORT:8091
Config.Description: Host port of the agent API (used by other hosts' dashboards to poll this one). Host networking: the value IS the host port.

Config.Name: AGENT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Shared token for agent API access — must be identical on the web instance and every agent (set a long random value).

Config.Name: TTYD_USER
Config.Description: SSH terminal tab login: username. The Terminal tab stays locked until both TTYD_USER and TTYD_PASS are set (the rest of the dashboard stays open). Leave both empty to disable the terminals.

Config.Name: TTYD_PASS
Config.Description: SSH terminal tab login: password (with TTYD_USER). Never stored — only compared against the credentials you type in the login form.

Config.Name: DOCKER_SOCK
Config.Description: Docker socket path for per-container rows. Keep the 'Docker Socket' path mapping below active; set to empty to disable.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Mount the Docker socket (read-only) so container names appear in the process list (per-container throughput).

Config.Name: Config Volume
Config.Description: Base directory for the settings page — servers.yaml is stored in the /netspy/config subfolder (created automatically). After install, make it world-writable on the host: chmod 777 /mnt/user/appdata/netspy (container runs as root with cap_drop ALL and needs write access).

Config.Name: CONFIG_DIR
Config.Description: Advanced: folder inside the container that holds servers.yaml. Empty = auto-detect (/netspy/config when the Config Volume above is mounted to /netspy). Only change it if you mount your config somewhere else.
